title: Beyond Recall: Behavioral Specification as an Interpretive Layer for AI Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2605.28969v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: If an AI agent makes decisions on a person's behalf, those decisions must align with its user. We introduce representational accuracy to measure how faithfully a system captures a person's interpretation. An interpretive layer is operationalized as a Behavioral Specification. Our reference implementation aggressively compresses a person's data into interpretive patterns, served as context to a language model. We evaluate the Specification on a prototype benchmark of held-out behavioral predictions scored by a calibrated 5-judge LLM panel. We test it independently and in composition with a range of context conditions: full raw corpus, full extracted facts, and four commercial memory systems (Mem0, Letta, Supermemory, Zep).   Across 14 public-domain autobiographical corpora, the Specification lifts representational accuracy in aggregate and nearly eliminates model hedging. It recovers most of what the raw corpus delivers, at ~25x

translated_title: 超越回忆：行为规范作为AI个性化的解释层
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.28969v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：如果一个人工智能代理代表其用户做出决策，那么这些决策必须与用户保持一致。我们引入了表征准确性来衡量系统在多大程度上忠实捕捉用户的解释。解释层被操作化为一种行为规范。我们的参考实现将用户数据激进压缩为解释模式，并作为上下文提供给语言模型。我们在一个原型基准上评估了该规范，该基准包含保留的行为预测，由校准的5法官LLM小组评分。我们独立测试了它，并与一系列上下文条件组合测试：完整原始语料库、完整提取事实，以及四种商业记忆系统（Mem0、Letta、Supermemory、Zep）。在14个公共领域的自传体语料库中，该规范在总体上提升了表征准确性，并几乎消除了模型的不确定性。它以约25倍的压缩率恢复了原始语料库提供的大部分内容。
tldr: 本文提出了一种行为规范作为AI个性化的解释层，通过激进压缩用户数据为解释模式，在约25倍压缩下提升了表征准确性并几乎消除模型不确定性，验证了其在个性化决策中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Behavioral Specification as an interpretive layer for AI personalization, which aggressively compresses user data into interpretive patterns, improving representational accuracy and nearly eliminating model hedging at ~25x compression, demonstrating effectiveness in personalized decision-making.
